configure(bytes32,address[],uint8,uint12.notice: Policy edits require an idle deployment. Running apps cannot have their witness set or final-stop protection weakened behind existing permits.

deposit(bytes32).notice: Funding is permissionless, but can never change the owner or policy.

transition((bytes32,uint64,uint64,uint8,.notice: Same intent retries are a no-op, never another app charge. Relays check the receipt/intention before submitting; two different intents for one generation race safely and only one can commit.

userdoc.notice: Event-driven assignment controller. Heartbeats/serving permits never enter this contract. Queued, Running and Stopped are the only paid transitions. An unchanged app has no timer and no renew method. Runtime affordability is read-only, and verified self-hosting is priced by the paired ledger. Witnesses are explicitly selected by each owner. More than 2/3 must attest a transition; 3 of 4 supports one Byzantine witness. They must durably fence a generation before voting it out. Consumers also enforce fresh generation reads and short-lived quorum permits. The contract cannot revoke a host's access to raw hardware; fencing is enforced at protected data boundaries.
